text:
kai: Kicking off APAC-edge GPU account ramp-up. Goal: create project/account + VNet, smoke a minimal GPU cluster, and hand off to oncall for final validation. Target window: next Tue maintenance window.

mira: ack. what's the CIDR plan for this region? we need to avoid overlap with eu/east fleets.

kai: proposing 10.240.64.0/22 for VPC root, with /24s per AZ for compute subnets. keeps us out of 10.240.0.0/18 used elsewhere. open to suggestions.

devon: +1 to that range. please add a separate /28 for transit/peering endpoints and a /27 for natgw.

anika: reminder: org policy requires tag template 'redwood:env,redwood:region,redwood:cost_center' at creation. ops-jen, can you confirm billing tag mapping?

ops-jen: billing tags: env=staging-edge, region=apac-edge, cost_center=infra-gpu. I'll precreate cost center mapping in billing console.

kai: infra checklist (high level):
- cloud account/project created + billing tags
- VPC/VNet with subnets, route tables, IGW/NAT, peering prep
- IAM roles + service accounts (node, deployer, monitoring)
- KMS key for cluster secrets
- quota requests submitted (GPUs, CPUs, ENIs, vCPUs)
- bootstrap AMI/instance profile + driver bake
- canary cluster + perf smoke (p40/p4 tests)
- cost estimates + tagging validation

mira: GPU quota request — what numbers are we asking for? current soft limits are tiny in this region.

kai: requesting 32 p4d-equivalent GPU quota to start (allows 4-6 small clusters). I'll file support ticket and link here.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-7721: "Quota increase: APAC-EDGE GPUs (p4d) to 32". ETA: 48-72h. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7721

devon: network nit: ensure we enable flow logs to central account and set retention 90d. Also add prefix list for egress to S3 endpoints (avoid internet for AMI bootstraps).

anika: adding IAM note: restrict node iam role to only S3:GetObject for AMI buckets + kms:Decrypt for secrets. No wildcard policies.

kai: smoke test plan (short):
1) Provision tiny k8s cluster 3x n1-standard + 1 GPU node (test instance).
2) Run container with nv-hostengine + nvidia-smi check.
3) Run 1-min throughput microbenchmark (latency under 35ms p99 for local model).
4) Verify KV cache persistence for prefix traffic.
5) Confirm autoscaler + spot-burst policies behave.

ops-jen: also validate private ECR/registry access from nodes; we've had issues with cross-account role for registry. I'll precreate the cross-account role.

mira: any requirements for private connectivity to control plane? customers want VPC peering and optional transit gateway.

kai: we'll set up VPC peering to control-plane project and add a route through peering-attachment. For transit gateway, mark as optional and document steps — skip for ramp unless SRE requests it.

devon: cost estimate: baseline small cluster with 1 p4d-equivalent node ~ $8/hr (ballpark) — include nat/egress and storage; add +30% for buffer. We'll put raw numbers in the runbook.

anika: preflight script I pushed:
```
# preflight checks
check_cidr --vpc 10.240.64.0/22
check_quota --gpus 32 --vcpus 4096
validate_tags --required redwood:env,redwood:region,redwood:cost_center
```
kai: thanks — will run after ticket is accepted. ops-jen, once quota hits, can you create the project and hand credentials to infra-deploy?

ops-jen: yep. plan: create project, enable APIs, attach KMS and org policy, then post creds in vault under path /projects/apac-edge. Will ping here when done.

infra-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance window booked Tue 03:00-06:00 UTC for resource creation and initial canary.

mira: final question: who owns post-handoff oncall validation?

kai: SRE oncall (ops lead) will own final validation. I'll ping oncall at the start of the window and run live checklist with them.

devon: I'll prep the AMI with drivers and test startup script. ETA EOD tomorrow.

anika: I'll update runbook with tagging examples, IAM snippets, and a copy of the preflight script.

ops-jen: leaving a quick note — ensure cost center is reflected in tags before any spot instances spin up or billing will misattribute.

kai: great — next steps: 1) wait for INF-7721 quota approval; 2) ops-jen creates project and posts creds; 3) devon bakes AMI; 4) run canary in maintenance window. I'll update this thread as we progress. :thumbsup:
